build_LSTMLRAEncoder: build a bidirectional LSTM encoder model with configurable layers, embedding dim, and hidden dim for sentence encoding
run_LSTMLRAEncoder_forward: run the LSTMLRAEncoder forward pass with token tensors and source lengths to get hidden states and sentence representations
create_LSTM_factory: create an initialized LSTM module with xavier uniform weight initialization and zero bias using the LSTM factory function
review_LSTMLRAEncoder_build_embedding: review the LSTMLRAEncoder build_embedding method that creates sparse nn.Embedding or RealNumberEmbedding based on embedding type
test_LSTMLRAEncoder_quant_noise: test the LSTMLRAEncoder quant noise linear layer application when q_noise is greater than zero
